destination.title: Geometry, protected amplitudes and brane/CFT data
destination.question: How do geometric and algebraic structures organize calculable data in string compactifications and supersymmetric field theories, and which adjacent CFT or holographic questions offer distinct comparisons?
destination.summary: The original proposal supplies numerical memberships without a scientific scope statement. These memberships are useful after distinguishing physical targets, dimensions, regimes and evidential status. Shared geometry, modularity or partition-function language does not establish question identity.

systems: Calabi–Yau geometries, branes and string compactifications
Specified supersymmetric gauge theories and BPS sectors
Two-dimensional CFTs, including Narain and rational theories
targets: Protected amplitudes, enumerative invariants and BPS spectra
Gauge content, effective actions and proposed vacuum mechanisms
Moduli geometry, phases, stability and limiting spectra
CFT classification, observables and proposed correspondences
regimes: Local and compact settings remain distinct
Spacetime dimension, genus, refinement and coupling limit remain source-specific
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible
assumptions: Numerical proximity is candidate provenance, not scientific evidence
A broad navigation family can contain different scoped questions
Conjectures and proposed mechanisms remain conditional
conventions: Fine singleton status retains the exact original source question without proving atomicity or uniqueness
Source-parent kinds and access points do not determine physical premises
includes: Separate access to computational, interpretive and consistency questions
excludes: A universal equivalence between all partition functions or geometries
Automatic transfer of results between dimensions or limits
Acceptance of graph-derived scattering or singularity resolution from description alone

sources.title: On NS5-brane instantons and volume stabilization

evidence.text: Can an Euclidean NS5-brane wrapping the entire Calabi–Yau contribute directly to overall-volume stabilization or uplift, and how can its corrections be represented in N = 2 supergravity and an orientifold-inspired N = 1 truncation?

sources.title: D-branes at Toric Singularities: Model Building, Yukawa Couplings and Flavour Physics

evidence.text: Determine what toric singularities constrain about family multiplicity, tree-level Yukawa rank and mass hierarchies, and whether explicit D-brane models contain enough structure for hierarchical CKM mixing and CP violation.

sources.title: F-Theory and the Landscape of Intersecting D7-Branes

evidence.text: How do elliptic Calabi–Yau deformations encode D7-brane positions and shapes, which orientifold intersections obstruct their motion, and how can this correspondence guide flux stabilization?

sources.title: D3/D7 Branes at Singularities: Constraints from Global Embedding and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: How can local models of fractional D3-branes and flavour D7-branes at del Pezzo singularities be embedded consistently in compact Type-IIB Calabi-Yau orientifolds, while retaining a tractable moduli-stabilization analysis?

sources.title: Refined swampland distance conjecture and exotic hybrid Calabi-Yaus

evidence.text: How do D-branes behave in the exotic phases, and how do the abelian GLSM descriptions of F-type examples connect to their multiparameter toric origins?

sources.title: Refined swampland distance conjecture and exotic hybrid Calabi-Yaus

evidence.text: Which matter-field singularities contribute when a one-parameter GLSM sphere partition function is evaluated by contour integration?

sources.title: Refined swampland distance conjecture and exotic hybrid Calabi-Yaus

evidence.text: How can the C2 small-radius partition function count overlapping p1 and p2 poles exactly once?

sources.title: Topological strings on genus one fibered Calabi-Yau 3-folds and string dualities

evidence.text: How can modularity determine all-genus BPS-index generating functions on compact genus-one fibered Calabi–Yau threefolds with reducible fibers and rational sections or N-sections, and test CHL dualities and refined limits with gravity decoupled?

sources.title: Modular curves, the Tate-Shafarevich group and Gopakumar-Vafa invariants with discrete charges

evidence.text: How do modular-curve cusps encode large-volume limits and Tate-Shafarevich elements of genus-one fibrations, including singular geometries, and how can their partition functions count BPS states with discrete charges?

sources.title: Higher d Eisenstein series and a duality-invariant distance measure

evidence.text: How can Petersson overlaps of general Narain partition functions with real analytic Eisenstein series be evaluated efficiently, and can the Petersson norm of partition-function differences provide a useful duality-invariant distance between two-dimensional CFTs?

sources.title: Topological strings and Higgsing trees

evidence.text: How can topological-string partition functions and BPS spectra be computed along rank-one 6d SCFT Higgsing trees, using modularity and non-critical-string current-algebra characters?

sources.title: Algebraic Realisation of the Zamolodchikov Metric in Narain Theories

evidence.text: Can a family of toroidal Narain CFTs be organized using finite-dimensional Lie algebras and their root/weight lattices, with algebraic expressions for the Zamolodchikov metric, partition functions and ensemble averages?

sources.title: Nonrenormalization theorem for $ \mathcal{N} $ = (4, 4) interface entropy

evidence.text: Can the Calabi-diastasis expression for supersymmetric interface entropy be extended to any pair of theories on one N=(4,4) conformal manifold, and explain the equality of free-orbifold and supergravity interface entropies in the D1–D5 system?

sources.title: D-brane gauge theories from toric singularities and toric duality

evidence.text: Given a toric singularity, recover at least one D-brane worldvolume gauge theory—matter content and superpotential—and investigate why different gauge theories can share its toric moduli-space data.

sources.title: Orientifolds of K3 and Calabi-Yau manifolds with intersecting D-branes

evidence.text: Can intersecting-brane orientifolds be extended beyond toroidal backgrounds to K3 and Calabi–Yau threefolds, with chiral spectra and consistency conditions determined geometrically rather than through explicit partition functions?

sources.title: Quantum foam and topological strings

evidence.text: Can the crystal-melting description of topological A-model amplitudes be interpreted as a target-space gravitational path integral over fluctuating Kähler geometry and topology, with a precise gauge-theory and sheaf-theoretic definition?

sources.title: Topological strings and their physical applications

evidence.text: How are topological strings defined and computed, and which protected quantities in supersymmetric gauge theories and four-/five-dimensional BPS black holes do they encode?

sources.title: Kodaira-Spencer theory of gravity and exact results for quantum string amplitudes

evidence.text: How can higher-genus amplitudes of critical twisted N=2 theories be computed despite failure of BRST-exact states to decouple, and what target-space geometry and four-dimensional interactions do these amplitudes encode?

sources.title: Selfdual strings and N=2 supersymmetric field theory

evidence.text: How does the Seiberg–Witten Riemann surface arise canonically from type II Calabi–Yau geometry, and can wrapped-brane geometry determine which allowed electric/magnetic charges actually support stable BPS particles?

sources.title: Branes and toric geometry

evidence.text: How can toric degeneration data translate between geometric engineering and brane configurations, explain restrictions of five-brane constructions, and give an intuitive T-duality account of global and local mirror symmetry?

sources.title: M theory, topological strings and spinning black holes

evidence.text: How can wrapped-M2 BPS spin data compute higher-genus topological strings, and what asymptotic constraints follow from spinning five-dimensional black holes?

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: Can the extra tadpole-canceling U(1) branes support a stable vacuum with no charged scalar VEVs and predominantly D-type supersymmetry breaking? The authors propose gauge interactions as a means of communicating this hidden-sector breaking to the Standard Model.

sources.title: Modularity from Monodromy

evidence.text: How does the relative Fourier–Mukai transformation with ideal-sheaf kernel IΔ act on brane charges for elliptically fibered Calabi–Yau threefolds, including reducible fibers, and when does its induced flat-coordinate action yield modular and Jacobi transformation laws?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Do non-supersymmetric AdS6 backgrounds associated with five-brane webs survive perturbative brane fluctuations and non-perturbative decay channels, permitting stable holographic five-dimensional CFTs?

sources.title: Aspects of AdS flux vacua with integer conformal dimensions

evidence.text: What structures accompany integer conformal dimensions in DGKT-type flux vacua, and when can leading flux scalings be obtained from near-horizon geometries of intersecting D-brane domain walls?

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: At fixed discrete flux data, solve holomorphicity for complex structure and zero-FI calibration for Kähler geometry. Positivity selects the physical branch. Charged scalar contributions require a different calibration equation and cannot be omitted from stacks that rely on Higgsing.

sources.title: On NS5-brane instantons and volume stabilization

evidence.text: Expand the N = 1 F-term potential and inverse Kähler metric to first order in the proposed instanton correction, then retain leading volume powers. Derivatives of the corrected metric involve all chiral fields, even when heavy fields obey supersymmetric stabilization conditions.

sources.title: D-branes at Toric Singularities: Model Building, Yukawa Couplings and Flavour Physics

evidence.text: Review and apply Gulotta's inverse dimer algorithm: embed a rotated toric diagram in a rectangular conifold orbifold, then partially resolve it by merging zigzag paths in Farey-tree order. Consistency requires controlling additional crossings and preserving the winding/web correspondence.

sources.title: F-Theory and the Landscape of Intersecting D7-Branes

evidence.text: Count deformations through polynomial coefficients, adjunction, Riemann–Roch and Riemann–Hurwitz; compare normal-bundle counting with odd canonical sections on a smooth abstract double-cover curve.

sources.title: D3/D7 Branes at Singularities: Constraints from Global Embedding and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Use Mukai charge vectors and their antisymmetric pairing to compute RR charges and chiral indices. Restrict global flavour-brane charges to the blow-up divisor, match the local quiver charges, and impose tadpole, Freed-Witten and probe-brane K-theory consistency conditions.

sources.title: Modularity from Monodromy

evidence.text: Uses the imported Γ-class expression for asymptotic large-volume central charges to obtain coordinate transformations. The cohomological dual changes sign by (−1)^i on H^(i,i). Line-bundle twists before and after the relative transformation define the modular S operation.

sources.title: A-D-E Classification of Conformal Field Theories

evidence.text: How do modular invariance and boundary consistency classify torus partition functions of affine sl(2) theories and Virasoro minimal models, and why do ADE Dynkin diagrams organize the answers? This is a review of established classifications.

sources.title: Moduli-dependent KK towers and the swampland distance conjecture on the quintic Calabi-Yau manifold

evidence.text: Does the large-complex-structure quintic spectrum approach a three-sphere base spectrum under torus collapse?

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in type II string theory

evidence.text: How do curves of Calabi–Yau singularities generate nonabelian gauge symmetry in four-dimensional Type II compactifications, and do their geometric transitions, periods and topological amplitudes match the proposed light-soliton theory?

sources.title: Twisted 6d (2, 0) SCFTs on a circle

evidence.text: How can BPS partition functions of outer-automorphism-twisted 6d (2,0) theories be determined from 5d instanton counting and twisted-string modularity, and what high-energy asymptotics follow?

sources.title: Holomorphic anomalies, fourfolds and fluxes

evidence.text: How do flux geometry and gravitational descendants determine holomorphic, modular and elliptic anomalies of genus-zero partition functions on elliptic Calabi–Yau fourfolds, and explain derivative relations between flux sectors?

sources.title: GLSM's for Gerbes (and other toric stacks)

evidence.text: Can GLSMs describe toric stacks through nonminimal charges, with nonperturbative observables and IR behavior depending on the stack rather than its presentation, and how do their mirrors encode finite stabilizer data?

sources.title: Duality origami: Emergent ensemble symmetries in holography and Swampland

evidence.text: How can toroidal Narain theories be extended beyond unimodular lattices while retaining a controlled moduli space? The paper fixes Q and allows its compatible Hamiltonian data H(m) to vary over an orthogonal double coset.

sources.title: The Topological vertex

evidence.text: Can one universal trivalent open-string amplitude, together with propagator and framing rules, compute all-genus topological A-model amplitudes on noncompact toric Calabi–Yau threefolds, and explain the construction through the mirror B-model?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from a D-term generated racetrack potential in hypersurface Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Which toric hypersurface Calabi–Yau compactifications and consistent D7-brane flux choices can implement the previously proposed D-term generated racetrack uplift, especially with exponent ratio β close to one?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: How can monodromy be interpreted in the real five-dimensional M-theory moduli space?

sources.title: Quantum Geometry of Refined Topological Strings

evidence.text: How do refined topological branes quantize local Calabi–Yau geometry, and can their wave-functions and monodromies explain the Nekrasov–Shatashvili connection between gauge partition functions and quantum integrable systems?

sources.title: D-instanton, threshold corrections, and topological string

evidence.text: Can the moduli-dependent one-loop prefactor of a Euclidean D-brane superpotential be determined through the CFIV index and topological amplitudes, avoiding direct knowledge of the full Calabi–Yau string spectrum?

sources.title: Mathematical Structures of Non-perturbative Topological String Theory: From GW to DT Invariants

evidence.text: How do directional Borel sums of the resolved-conifold Gromov–Witten potential encode Donaldson–Thomas invariants, Riemann–Hilbert problems and BPS wall crossing at weak and strong topological string coupling?

sources.title: Topological Strings on Non-commutative Resolutions

evidence.text: What enumerative invariants are encoded by topological strings on non-commutative resolutions of terminal nodal Calabi–Yau threefolds, and how do they record discrete M-theory charges?

sources.title: Local mirror symmetry at higher genus

evidence.text: Can local mirror symmetry compute higher-genus topological-string amplitudes for curves supported on Fano surfaces, reproduce localization invariants, and organize them into integral BPS coefficients with interpretable large-degree growth?

sources.title: Spectral networks

evidence.text: How can trajectories on a surface determine surface-defect soliton indices and bulk 4d BPS degeneracies, and produce coordinates on moduli spaces of flat connections?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: An orientifold limit provides a conditional dictionary between G2 cycles and Calabi-Yau parity sectors, permitting tests of which wrapped-brane arguments survive the quotient.

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Can locations of maximal enhancement characterize the higher-dimensional Narain fundamental region?

sources.title: Dimer models from mirror symmetry and quivering amoebae

evidence.text: What string-geometric mechanism makes torus dimer models encode the gauge groups, matter and tree-level superpotential of D3-branes at toric Calabi–Yau singularities?

sources.title: The Octagon and the Non-Supersymmetric String Landscape

evidence.text: Can fractional D3-branes at an orientifolded toric Calabi–Yau singularity engineer a fully stable dynamical supersymmetry-breaking vacuum, avoiding the known instability caused by N = 2 fractional branes?

sources.title: Quantum Calabi-Yau and classical crystals

evidence.text: Does the topological A-model at large string coupling admit a classical crystal-melting description, and can fixed crystal asymptotes reproduce the topological vertex and extend to local toric Calabi–Yau threefolds?

sources.title: Gauge theories from toric geometry and brane tilings

evidence.text: How much of a four-dimensional superconformal quiver theory—field multiplicities, global charges, interactions and gauge nodes—can be extracted from a toric Calabi–Yau singularity and assembled using brane tilings?

sources.title: Spectral Networks and Snakes

evidence.text: How can spectral networks near lifted A1 loci make higher-rank class-S theories tractable, recover Fock–Goncharov coordinates, and determine BPS spectrum generators?

sources.title: The Effective action of D7-branes in N = 1 Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: Determine the four-dimensional N=1 effective action of a wrapped D7-brane, especially its couplings to bulk moduli, using geometrical data of a generic Calabi–Yau orientifold rather than a specified compactification.

sources.title: Liouville Correlation Functions from Four-dimensional Gauge Theories

evidence.text: Can Nekrasov partition functions of the specified four-dimensional N=2 theories reproduce Virasoro conformal blocks and Liouville correlators on the Riemann surfaces defining those theories?

sources.title: Abelian varieties, RCFTs, attractors, and Hitchin functional in two dimensions

evidence.text: Construct a two-dimensional Hitchin analog and quantum theory whose conformal-block generating function supplies an entropy weight on complex-structure moduli, especially for c = 2g toroidal RCFTs, as a toy model for quantum topological M-theory.

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: This toroidal orientifold makes calibrated-brane stability and charge cones explicit through four dilaton-weighted periods, with fixed Kähler moduli in the D4 examples.

sources.title: Discrete Symmetries in Dimer Diagrams

evidence.text: How can discrete global symmetries of D3-brane quiver theories for cyclic orbifolds of general toric Calabi–Yau threefold singularities be constructed systematically from the parent dimer?

sources.title: Wall-crossing, Hitchin systems, and the WKB approximation

evidence.text: How can BPS spectra and Kontsevich–Soibelman wall-crossing be obtained geometrically for rank-two class S theories, using canonical Darboux coordinates on ramified Hitchin moduli spaces?

sources.title: Framed BPS States

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric line operators encode spin-resolved BPS spectra, ordinary wall crossing, and holomorphic observables on compactified vacuum moduli spaces?

sources.title: M theory and topological strings. 1.

evidence.text: Can the protected topological A-model amplitudes of type IIA on a Calabi–Yau threefold be understood through a one-loop M-theory calculation, including constant maps, spherical bubbling and information beyond the graviphoton expansion?

sources.title: Monstrous moonshine and the classification of CFT

evidence.text: Introduce the classification of rational CFT partition functions and explain Monstrous Moonshine through modular functions, representations, vertex operator algebras and generalised Kac–Moody algebras. These are pedagogical lectures reviewing existing developments.

sources.title: M theory and topological strings. 2.

evidence.text: What precise BPS information about wrapped M2-branes is encoded by Calabi–Yau threefold topological-string amplitudes, and how does dependence on the string coupling record five-dimensional spin?

sources.title: Refined BPS numbers on compact Calabi-Yau threefolds from Wilson loops

evidence.text: Can refined BPS spectra of compact elliptically fibred Calabi–Yau threefolds be reconstructed from Wilson-loop observables in their rigid local limits, including dependence on complex structure?

sources.title: Averaging over moduli in deformed WZW models

evidence.text: What is the moduli-averaged torus partition function of current-current-deformed WZW models, and can its modular sum support a three-dimensional holographic interpretation extending Narain ensemble duality?

sources.title: Duality origami: Emergent ensemble symmetries in holography and Swampland

evidence.text: Which topological gauge theories provide the local bulk building blocks for generalized Narain ensemble holography? The paper fixes an even integral level matrix Q and studies the resulting bosonic Abelian theory.

sources.title: Calabi-Yau fourfolds for M theory and F theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which explicit Calabi-Yau fourfold deformation families support M- and F-theory compactifications, and how do their topology, instanton divisors, elliptic degenerations, transitions and quantum cohomology encode effective-theory properties?

sources.title: Holomorphic anomalies in topological field theories

evidence.text: How can the genus-one generalized index of an N=2 SCFT be computed through its holomorphic anomaly, and how does its topological limit encode elliptic curves on Calabi–Yau targets?

destination.title: Flux vacua, localized sources and effective gravity
destination.question: How do flux compactifications realize lower-dimensional vacua, and what controls their sources, moduli, spectra and effective descriptions?
destination.summary: A proposed family connecting vacuum construction with higher-dimensional consistency and effective-gravity tests. Its sources differ in dimension, supersymmetry, geometry, approximation and observable. Numerical membership supplies no equivalence between them.

sources.title: AdS4 flux vacua in type II superstrings and their domain-wall solutions

evidence.text: Can perturbative type II compactifications produce supersymmetric AdS4 extrema with finite main moduli, and can their sources form domain walls connecting an AdS4 region to flat spacetime?

sources.title: The Effective theory of type IIA AdS(4) compactifications on nilmanifolds and cosets

evidence.text: What four-dimensional effective actions and light scalar spectra arise in the studied nilmanifold and coset AdS4 compactifications, and can geometric flux permit scale separation or evade the cited type IIA inflation no-go theorem?

sources.title: Heterotic compactifications on nearly Kahler manifolds

evidence.text: Can nearly Kähler heterotic AdS compactifications satisfy supersymmetry, anomaly cancellation, and the order-α′ equations of motion simultaneously, and how do the tangent-bundle connection and gaugino condensate affect existence and volume fixing?

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What additional charge sources permit four-dimensional M-theory and conventional type IIA compactifications with internal four-form flux despite supergravity no-go constraints? The paper also assesses a specific massive-IIA proposal for parametrically separated AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales.

sources.title: AdS vacua with scale separation from IIB supergravity

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB supergravity with O5/O7 sources produce supersymmetric AdS4 compactifications admitting weak coupling, large internal volume, and an AdS radius parametrically larger than the compactification scale?

sources.title: AdS$_{4}$ compactifications of AdS$_{7}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: Can localized-source AdS7 solutions of massive IIA yield supersymmetric AdS4 compactifications through a twist over a compact three-manifold, and can the construction produce more general regular or sourced vacua?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does massive IIA O6-core resolution preserve the low-energy spectrum and hierarchy inferred from bulk supergravity? What next-order Kähler data and internal geometric structure describe the localized vacua?

sources.title: Smearing orientifolds in flux compactifications can be OK

evidence.text: Can massive IIA compactifications with localized O6 sources solve the ten-dimensional supergravity equations, and when does their smeared description approximate the localized fields? A second question concerns an exotic example whose unwarped internal boundary disappears after backreaction.

sources.title: The holographic conformal manifold of 3d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 S-fold SCFTs

evidence.text: Can one construct a two-real-parameter family of N = 2 AdS4 J-fold vacua connecting known symmetry-enhanced solutions, and use holography to determine the corresponding conformal-manifold geometry and coupling-dependent operator spectrum?

sources.title: Leaps and bounds towards scale separation

evidence.text: What rigorous restrictions do higher-dimensional equations place on Kaluza–Klein masses and scale separation, and can Romans mass replace the problematic O6 loci in promising supersymmetric AdS4 compactifications by smooth local geometry?

sources.title: Smearing and unsmearing KKLT AdS vacua

evidence.text: Can KKLT supersymmetric AdS₄ vacua with gaugino condensation be described consistently in ten dimensions, including smeared solutions, conditional scale separation and the divergent on-shell action for localized sources?

sources.title: New families of scale separated vacua

evidence.text: Which additional supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 flux-vacuum branches admit parametric separation from the compactification scale, and can asymmetric flux rescalings generate such families beyond twisted toroidal examples?

sources.title: Weak <math display="inline"><msub><mi>G</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> manifolds and scale separation in M-theory from type IIA backgrounds

evidence.text: Can localising O6-planes in the scale-separated massless-IIA Iwasawa background preserve supersymmetry and produce an M-theory Freund–Rubin vacuum on a weak G2 space whose KK scale decouples from its curvature scale?

sources.title: AdS4 flux vacua in type II superstrings and their domain-wall solutions

evidence.text: Specify duality directions and transform bulk fields, sources and the effective Kähler/superpotential pair. In these constructions, transverse NS5 duality produces KK monopoles and geometric flux.

sources.title: The Effective theory of type IIA AdS(4) compactifications on nilmanifolds and cosets

evidence.text: Uses imported pure-spinor expressions for the superpotential and Kähler potential, with Mukai pairings, to construct the N=1 scalar potential. Physical scalar masses require diagonalizing the Hessian with the inverse scalar kinetic metric.

sources.title: Heterotic compactifications on nearly Kahler manifolds

evidence.text: The equations are split into external and internal components. Factorized gaugino spinors obey a massless external Dirac equation, and assumed quantum averages of external bilinears supply a condensate source for the bosonic equations.

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Trace and integrate warped Einstein equations to obtain cosmological-constant constraints, while retaining stronger pointwise conditions. In massive IIA, examine both the dilaton equation and external Einstein equation together with the localized-source Bianchi identity.

sources.title: AdS vacua with scale separation from IIB supergravity

evidence.text: Decompose geometry and fluxes into SU(2) torsion representations. With left-invariant forms, solve algebraic supersymmetry conditions, Bianchi identities and d²=0 consistency conditions, then determine source terms from the remaining RR Bianchi identities.

sources.title: AdS$_{4}$ compactifications of AdS$_{7}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: The natural system is solved analytically through a function β and maps from the AdS5 construction discussed by the authors. Endpoint classification uses a simple zero of β for regularity, a double zero for D6 charge, and square-root behavior for an O6 singularity.

sources.title: Global properties of the conformal manifold for S-fold backgrounds

evidence.text: What are the ten-dimensional interpretation, global identifications and Kaluza–Klein consequences of the apparently noncompact modulus χ in a one-parameter family of N=2 AdS4 vacua?

sources.title: Massive Anti-de Sitter Gravity from String Theory

evidence.text: Can type-IIB string theory realize a parametrically light massive AdS4 graviton, and can its mass be expressed using only effective bag gravity, throat D3 charges, and dilaton jumps?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does massive type IIA replace apparent O6 singularities by a regular nonlinear solution, or are string corrections essential inside the cores?

sources.title: Type-IIA flux compactifications and N=4 gauged supergravities

evidence.text: How do geometric Type-IIA O6 flux compactifications map precisely to N = 4 gauging parameters and consistency constraints, and which previously known N = 1 AdS₄ vacua admit extended-supergravity embeddings?

sources.title: A Second look at N=1 supersymmetric AdS(4) vacua of type IIA supergravity

evidence.text: Identify the ten-dimensional geometry behind a class of effective four-dimensional N=1 IIA AdS vacua, construct sources satisfying its RR two-form Bianchi identity, and exhibit a non-nearly-Kähler compactification within the same supersymmetry framework.

sources.title: Type IIB flux compactifications with h$^{1,1}$ = 0

evidence.text: Can nongeometric type IIB compactifications without Kähler moduli provide fully stabilized Minkowski, AdS and dS solutions, and broaden tests of swampland conjectures beyond geometric supergravity constructions?

sources.title: On the spin-2 Kaluza-Klein spectrum of $ {\mathrm{AdS}}_4\times {S}^2\left({\mathrm{\mathcal{B}}}_4\right) $

evidence.text: Can tuning the data of supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS4×S^2(B4) vacua separate the AdS curvature scale from the spin-2 Kaluza-Klein scale, or does every admissible solution retain a light massive graviton?

sources.title: No-scale and scale-separated flux vacua from IIA on G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIA flux compactification on G₂ orientifolds provide a three-dimensional effective supergravity with no-scale Minkowski vacua and classically stabilized AdS₃ vacua whose KK and AdS scales separate parametrically at weak coupling and large volume?

sources.title: AdS strings with torsion: Non-complex heterotic compactifications

evidence.text: How do H flux and gaugino condensation jointly constrain supersymmetric heterotic AdS4 compactifications in ten dimensions, and how do the resulting geometry, moduli arguments and vacuum energy relate to the four-dimensional effective description?

sources.title: Supersymmetric scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ orientifold vacua of type IIB

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB compactifications yield minimally supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with stabilized geometric scalars, weak coupling, large internal radii and parametric separation between the AdS and KK scales?

sources.title: Supersymmetric AdS(4) compactifications of IIA supergravity

evidence.text: What necessary and sufficient conditions characterize N=1 AdS4 compactifications of massive or massless IIA supergravity within the paper's SU(3)-structure ansatz, including Bianchi identities and equations of motion?

sources.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can classical massive Type IIA compactifications produce parametrically scale-separated AdS3 vacua preserving extended supersymmetry, with a consistent three-dimensional N=2 effective description?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: How do localized orientifold charge and stress-energy enter an AdS4 flux compactification? The setting fixes the frame, improved field strengths, source distributions, and tangent projectors needed to formulate localization.

sources.title: Massive gravitons on the Landscape and the AdS Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: How can type-IIB embeddings of AdS4 massive/bimetric gravity be extended to multiple light massive gravitons, and how does the distance-conjecture tower scale compare with the effective theory's breakdown scale?

sources.title: Localized O6-plane solutions with Romans mass

evidence.text: Do localized supersymmetric O6 solutions exist with Romans mass, and what replaces the singular, unphysical region of the massless O6 when an eleven-dimensional lift is unavailable?

sources.title: Massive AdS Supergravitons and Holography

evidence.text: Which dimensions and supersymmetries permit parametrically light massive AdS supergravitons through holographic coupling of two SCFTs, and what microscopic physics explains the effective theory's breakdown as the graviton mass vanishes?

sources.title: Kähler moduli stabilization from ten dimensions

evidence.text: Can localized gaugino condensation, its geometric backreaction, and Kähler-modulus stabilization in supersymmetric KKLT-type AdS vacua be described directly in ten dimensions, and can that description recover the four-dimensional vacuum relation?

destination.title: Moduli stabilization, supersymmetry breaking and observable consequences
destination.question: Under which source-specific conditions can moduli stabilization coexist with hierarchical scales and supersymmetry breaking, and what follows for mediation, flavor and other observable couplings?
destination.summary: A proposed navigation family spanning different compactifications and effective theories. Construction, phenomenological consequences and checks on assumed scale hierarchies remain distinguishable. Numerical membership alone does not establish scientific inclusion or equivalence.

systems: G2 compactifications and fluxless M theory
Associated moduli and matter effective theories
targets: Compatible stabilization, hierarchical scales and supersymmetry breaking
regimes: Flux-supported and explicitly fluxless constructions kept separate
Supersymmetric stabilization followed by lower-scale breaking, or joint stabilization and breaking
assumptions: No common Kähler potential, hidden-sector content or vacuum-energy prescription is imposed
Successful stabilization, cosmological viability and present experimental viability are separate questions
conventions: Model parameters and mass symbols retain their source-specific meanings
includes: Modular flavor as an overlapping application
excludes: Universal success of the proposed constructions
A universal requirement of hierarchically small W0
Standalone goldstino transitions and entanglement-induced coupling statistics as core stabilization questions

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Supersymmetry Breaking in Deflected Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Can stabilizing a visible-sector singlet in a KKLT-motivated effective theory produce gauge mediation comparable to modulus and anomaly mediation, and how do messenger thresholds change soft terms and low-energy spectra?

sources.title: Kahler Independence of the G(2)-MSSM

evidence.text: How robust are G2-MSSM stabilization and soft spectra when the moduli Kähler potential uses a general G2 volume and matter metrics are generalized? Can higher matter contact terms connect flavor-sensitive physics to LSP identity?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking, Moduli Stabilization and Hidden U(1) Breaking in M-Theory

evidence.text: Can one confining hidden gauge sector together with a membrane-instanton cubic interaction of hidden U(1)-charged matter stabilize G2 compactification moduli, break supersymmetry and the hidden gauge symmetry, and produce viable soft supersymmetry-breaking parameters?

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled heterotic compactifications stabilize geometric and gauge-bundle moduli with a phenomenologically suitable gauge coupling, while generating spontaneous supersymmetry breaking and approximately Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: A Note on the Magnitude of the Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Do effective-field-theory consistency, phenomenology or vacuum statistics require a hierarchically small type IIB flux superpotential, or can generic W0 of order 1–10 remain consistent after moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Log(M(Pl) / m(3/2))

evidence.text: Can flux compactification retain a dynamical explanation of the weak/Planck hierarchy by replacing a tuned superpotential constant with an adjustable continuous quantity, and how does nonperturbative modulus stabilization produce logarithmically separated modulus, gravitino and soft masses?

sources.title: Explaining the Electroweak Scale and Stabilizing Moduli in M Theory

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative hidden-sector gauge dynamics simultaneously stabilize moduli and generate the weak–Planck hierarchy in fluxless M theory, and produce sufficiently general predictions for supersymmetry-breaking masses?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Supersymmetry Breaking in Deflected Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Soft terms follow from spurion continuation of gauge kinetic functions and matter metrics into superspace, with compensator-dependent renormalization, messenger matching, and RG evolution above and below the threshold.

sources.title: Kahler Independence of the G(2)-MSSM

evidence.text: Authors minimize the supergravity potential through inverse-hidden-cycle-volume expansions and numerical toy examples. Electroweak spectra use two-loop SOFTSUSY evolution, thresholds from heavy states and iterative gauge-unification matching.

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking, Moduli Stabilization and Hidden U(1) Breaking in M-Theory

evidence.text: The authors construct the supergravity F-term potential using KU(1)=Σa|Ta|²/VX, introduce a moduli-vev ansatz, and expand extrema in the weak hidden gauge coupling αHS. Determining the homogeneity coefficients requires solving transcendental equations and imposing positive moduli.

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Four-dimensional F- and D-term supergravity is expanded in loop- and volume-suppressed parameters. With Φ = S − βb Tb/2, the leading equations DZ Ŵ = DΦ Ŵ = 0 fix heavy fields; threshold effects, worldsheet instantons and α′²/α′³ Kähler corrections generate the subleading Kähler potential energy.

sources.title: A Note on the Magnitude of the Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Vacuum statistics are estimated by counting annuli in the complex W0 plane and changing variables to vacuum energy using the stated KKLT and LVS stabilization scalings.

sources.title: Log(M(Pl) / m(3/2))

evidence.text: Hidden-sector dimensional transmutation supplies ⟨λλ⟩=Λ³, with Λ approximately μ exp[-1/(b0 g²(μ))]. Gaugino condensation is represented by a nonperturbative superpotential term C exp(-af).

sources.title: Moduli potentials in string compactifications with fluxes: Mapping the discretuum

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications stabilize all moduli through F-terms while producing broken supersymmetry, a small nonnegative cosmological constant, and a hierarchy within weak coupling and large volume? Are the resulting vacua cosmologically viable?

sources.title: On Gauge Mediated SUSY Breaking and Moduli Stabilization

evidence.text: Can gauge-mediated SUSY breaking dominate in a type IIB model with stabilized moduli and tuned vacuum energy, and can the SUSY-breaking matter sector consistently be treated independently of nonperturbatively stabilized Kähler moduli?

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects of F theory

evidence.text: Can the additional nonperturbative gauge sectors accessible through F-theory stabilize weak observable gauge couplings while preserving supersymmetry at the stabilization scale and allowing its eventual breakdown at a hierarchically lower scale?

sources.title: Radiative correction on moduli stabilization in modular flavor symmetric models

evidence.text: Can matter-induced Coleman–Weinberg corrections displace a stabilized complex-structure modulus slightly from the residual-symmetry point τ = ω, producing the small symmetry breaking useful for modular flavor hierarchies?

sources.title: Testing String Vacua in the Lab: From a Hidden CMB to Dark Forces in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can type IIB flux compactifications produce experimentally interesting hidden-photon masses and kinetic mixing while consistently stabilizing moduli, including the D-terms generated by the mass-producing flux?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric fluxes generate an exponentially small gravitino mass while retaining a high string scale and stabilizing all moduli, by first constructing perturbative W=0 Minkowski vacua and then introducing small non-perturbative effects?

sources.title: Superpotential de-sequestering in string models

evidence.text: When do geometrically distant moduli-stabilising effects or hidden scalar vevs induce visible-sector Yukawa couplings with new flavour structure, undermining sequestering and contributing to flavour violation?

sources.title: An M theory Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can strong hidden-sector gauge dynamics in fluxless G₂ compactifications stabilize moduli while generating the electroweak–Planck hierarchy, and what supersymmetry-breaking soft spectrum follows?

sources.title: Sequestering in String Theory

evidence.text: Can type IIB compactifications suppress flavor-violating hidden–visible supersymmetry-breaking couplings despite compactification moduli, and can strong warping provide robust sequestering suitable for flavor-blind mediation?

sources.title: Remarks on the racetrack scheme

evidence.text: Can competing strong gauge dynamics stabilize a modulus at weak, unified gauge coupling while generating a hierarchy and retaining calculable low-energy quantities?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can a non-geometric flux sector generate the small constants needed by an ISS supersymmetry-breaking sector while stabilizing its gauge-coupling modulus perturbatively?
